headline: Peers agree on the basics, and are still working out helpdesk and AI.

themes.title: A settled core, a contested edge
body: Across the round, [[Microsoft 365]] is the clearest standard, while [[Neon One]] holds a solid Adopt among those who use it.
Ratings for [[QuickBooks]] and [[Odoo POS]] are split, which is a sign that the same tool lands differently depending on how long it has been in real use.

themes.title: Caution around helpdesk spend
body: [[Zendesk]] draws a caution from the named organisations that use it. Cost and fit were the reasons given.
